description: This PHP source file defines the 'Marketplace' controller class within the Opencart admin module. It handles marketplace-related functionalities such as listing extensions, viewing extension details, making purchases, downloading extensions, managing comments, and related API interactions with the remote marketplace server.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: The 'Marketplace' controller class manages marketplace interactions in the admin panel, including listing extensions, viewing details, handling purchases, downloads, comments, and API communication with the remote marketplace server.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main page method that renders the marketplace listing page, setting up filters, sorting, breadcrumbs, API key validation, and loading the marketplace view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Simplifies fetching the list view, delegating to getList, mainly for AJAX or API calls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches a list of marketplace extensions from the remote server, handling filtering, sorting, pagination, and assembling the data for rendering the list view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific extension from the remote server, including description, images, ratings, download links, and renders the extension detail page.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Manages extension download, install, uninstall, and delete operations based on session data and user permissions.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Handles the API-based purchase process for extensions, including signature creation, request signing, and handling API responses.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Manages downloading extension packages from remote server, saving files locally, and recording installations.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Submits a new comment on an extension via API, including signature authentication.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Fetches comments for an extension, paginates comments, and renders the comments view.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Fetches replies to a specific comment, manages pagination, and renders reply view.
